title: Let's go to the cinema!
objective: Inviter, accepter ou refuser en justifiant, fixer un rendez-vous

steps.title: Warm-up: film genres
steps.student_instruction: Look at four film posters. Say the genre: horror, comedy, romantic comedy, science fiction. Which one do you like?
steps.facilitator_instruction: Afficher quatre affiches inventées ; faire voter la classe et noter au tableau I love / I like / I don't like / I hate.

steps.title: Listening: inviting someone to the cinema
steps.student_instruction: Listen twice. Note the films they don't want, the film they choose, the time and the meeting place.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Audio British Council « Inviting someone to the cinema » (QR code du cahier) ; sans réseau, lire deux fois le script de secours. Seconde écoute ciblée sur les refus et leurs raisons.

steps.title: Language focus: inviting and answering
steps.student_instruction: Complete: Would you like to...? / Do you want to...? - Yes, great! / Sorry, I can't, I... / No thanks, I don't like...
steps.facilitator_instruction: Would you like to + verbe ; refuser poliment et justifier avec because. Rendez-vous : at + heure, outside / in front of + lieu.

steps.title: Differentiated practice
steps.student_instruction: Complete your A, B or C sheet, then compare with a partner.
steps.facilitator_instruction: A : associer invitations et réponses ; B : compléter un agenda et répondre à trois invitations ; C : écrire un message d'invitation et deux réponses (oui / non justifié).

steps.title: Pair task: plan a night out
steps.student_instruction: With your diary card, invite your partner. Agree on a film, a day, a time and a place to meet.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Distribuer des agendas avec des créneaux occupés différents pour forcer au moins un refus justifié. Vérifier que chaque binôme note le rendez-vous final.

steps.title: Exit ticket
steps.student_instruction: Write one invitation and one polite refusal with because.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Ramasser ; repérer Would you like + to et la justification.

sheets.student_content: Match: 1) Would you like to go to the cinema? 2) What time? 3) Where do we meet? 4) Do you like horror films? - a) Outside the cinema. b) No, I hate them! c) Yes, great idea! d) At eight o'clock.
Look at your diary for Saturday. Answer three invitations: accept one, refuse two and give a reason for each refusal.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Exemple : Sorry, I can't, I've got a piano lesson. / No thanks, I don't like comedies. Yes, great! What time?

sheets.student_content: Write a message to invite two friends to the cinema (film, day, time, meeting place). Then write one friend's answer: yes or no, with a reason.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Production libre ; attendus : Would you like to..., heure avec at, lieu de rendez-vous, refus justifié avec because.

criteria: L'élève accepte ou refuse en donnant une raison
L'élève fixe une heure et un lieu de rendez-vous

common_errors: Would you like go (oubli de to)
theme: À la rencontre de l'autre - les loisirs
